Implemented in [output/iges.cpp](/workspace/output/iges.cpp) with the build file at [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It builds with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`, producing `build/iges`.

The tool now supports the required subcommands, fixed-format IGES parsing/writing, canonical JSON output, DE lookup, diagnostic JSON failures, and point evaluation for the supported parametric curve/surface set. `eval` emits contract-compliant `tangent: null` and `normal: null`. I also wired `roundtrip` through the same canonical model and smoke-tested `write`, `parse`, `roundtrip`, and `eval` on a simple Line entity case. I did not run a broader real-world CAD corpus in this environment.
